title: Extended star hull: removing a gate set and its single-centred AND/OR readers, re-served by stars x_c AND OR(O_c), costs exactly the counted gates
formal_statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (Om Rd : Finset ℕ) (cls : ℕ → Fin n) (O : Fin n → Finset ℕ),
  PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ →
  (∀ k ∈ Om, k < C.gates.length ∧ C.output ≠ n + k) →
  (∀ X : ℕ, X ∈ Rd ↔ (X < C.gates.length ∧ X ∉ Om ∧
      ∃ k ∈ Om, n + k ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C X).inputs)) →
  (∀ X ∈ Rd, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C X).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧
      PEqualNP.TopForm.BelowF G C X ∧
      ∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n C X (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput u v) = true →
        u = cls X ∨ v = cls X) →
  (∀ c : Fin n, ∀ w ∈ O c,
      (w < n ∨ (n ≤ w ∧ w - n < C.gates.length ∧ ∀ k ∈ Om, k ≠ w - n ∧ ¬ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n C k (w - n))) ∧
      ∃ Z : Finset (Fin n), Z.Nonempty ∧ (∀ z ∈ Z, G.Adj c z) ∧
        ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD w false = decide (∃ z ∈ Z, x z = true)) →
  (∀ X ∈ Rd, ∀ q : Fin n, G.Adj (cls X) q →
      PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n C X (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput (cls X) q) = true →
      ∃ w ∈ O (cls X), (C.wires (List.ofFn (PEqualNP.SplitCount.unitInput q))).getD w false = true) →
  ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n D ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n D = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ ∧
    D.size + Om.card + Rd.card ≤ C.size + ∑ c ∈ Rd.image cls, (O c).card
plain_statement: G a graph, F its edge function, C an AND/OR circuit, each gate reading two earlier wires (so it reads only earlier wires), computing F. Omega: gates, not the output. Readers: gates outside Omega reading a member; each an AND below F whose accepted edges all contain its centre cls(X). For each c, O_c: wires with cones missing Omega, each an OR of neighbours of c, such that every far end q of an edge cq a reader of centre c accepts is reached by some w in O_c. Then some such circuit computes F with at most |C| - |Omega| - (readers) + (sum of |O_c| over readers' centres) gates.

retired.why: faithfulness NO on the title: it said 'costs exactly the counted gates' while the term is an upper bound; refiled with 'at most', term and plain unchanged
